caption: The drawing shows a round, shallow plate with a decorated surface and a side profile view beneath it. The top view of the plate features a beige or light tan background with a network of intersecting diagonal brown lines forming a diamond pattern, with greenish-blue spots or patches inside some of the diamonds. Around the central design, there is a wide border with multiple rings of color—beige, green, and brown—with additional brown zigzag and dotted patterns. The side view below the plate is a simple, solid brown curved semicircle, representing the profile of the plate. The drawing is set on an off-white or light beige background. In the lower left corner of the image, the name "Aaron Fastbussy" is written in cursive.
title: Pa. German Plate
